name: plugin-profiles
description: Switch which installed plugins are on with named profiles: one YAML file per profile, shipped, per user and per repository. A command-line tool previews each change, checks required prerequisites, writes only plugin and hidden-skill entries to a folder, user settings or a one-session file, and clear restores the file. A /plugin-profile command switches inside a session, a session-start notice names the profile, and guided setup builds profiles and installs a plugin only on a yes.

remember_folder_profile.title: Remember each folder's profile
remember_folder_profile.description: When on, a profile applied to a folder holds for every later session there. When off, every session starts from the initial profile: a folder apply is refused, and the session-start notice names a folder profile left from before as not in force. Read from managed settings first, then user settings.

session_start_profile_enabled.title: Session-start profile hook
session_start_profile_enabled.description: When on, the SessionStart hook names the folder's plugin profile and records each session's profile. Off, it does nothing. Your value wins when set; otherwise the repository's docs/conventions/plugin-profiles.yaml decides.

plugin_profile_module_enabled.title: Plugin-profile module hook
plugin_profile_module_enabled.description: When on, the mod registers /plugin-profile, the in-session switch, and its turn-end /reload-plugins. Off, sessions start without the command; profiles.mjs still works. Your value wins when set; otherwise the repository's docs/conventions/plugin-profiles.yaml decides.
